 School holidays November 2026: Check complete list of festivals and state-wise holidays
 School students can expect several holidays in November 2026 due to festivals like Diwali, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti. Check the complete state-wise festival list and important dates.
 Curated by Yash Wardhan Singh 
 Image: iStock 
 Nov 02, 2026
 Share
 November 2026 will bring several holidays for school students across India as the country prepares to celebrate a number of festivals. After Navratri, Durga Puja and Dussehra celebrations last month, people will observe Diwali, Govardhan Puja, Bhai Dooj, Chhath Puja and Guru Nanak Jayanti this month. 
 Students and parents should remember that school closure dates will not be the same everywhere. Holidays will depend on the festivals celebrated in each state, local traditions and the rules followed by individual schools. They should also check the latest government notices to confirm the dates of festivals and official holidays. 
 November 2026: Complete list of festivals and important dates 
 November 1 (Sunday): Kannada Rajyotsava / Haryana Day – Karnataka and Haryana. 
 November 6 (Friday): Dhanteras – Celebrated across India, but it is not a compulsory school holiday everywhere. 
 November 8 (Sunday): Diwali / Deepavali / Naraka Chaturdashi – Celebrated across India. 
 November 9 (Monday): Govardhan Puja / Annakut – Uttar Pradesh, Delhi, Rajasthan and other states. 
 November 11 (Wednesday): Bhai Dooj / Bhaiya Dooj – Several northern and western states. 
 November 14 (Saturday): Children's Day – Celebrated in schools across India, but it is not a general holiday. 
 November 15 (Sunday): Chhath Puja – Bihar, Jharkhand, eastern Uttar Pradesh and parts of Delhi. 
 November 16 (Monday): Veerangana Uda Devi Martyrdom Day – Uttar Pradesh. 
 November 24 (Tuesday): Guru Nanak Jayanti / Gurpurab / Kartik Purnima – Punjab, Haryana, Delhi and several other states. 
 These festivals are celebrated in different states and regions of India. However, some festivals are limited to particular areas and are not observed across the country. As a result, school holiday dates will depend on regional celebrations and the holiday list issued by each state government. 
 At the same time, several states have released their Class 10 and Class 12 board exam timetables, while others are expected to announce them soon. Schools may also arrange pre-board examinations or give students preparation breaks before their board exams. These dates and plans will depend on the individual school's schedule.
